name: EH Magnetic Antenna
description: The EH Magnetic Antenna is a compact HF antenna that uses phased electric and magnetic fields generated by two closely spaced cylinders. It is designed for extremely small physical size relative to wavelength, making it suitable for restricted-space HF operation.
modelingNotes: Two cylinders create phased E and H fields for radiation.
Spacing and cylinder dimensions determine resonance.
Tuning capacitance controls phasing and match.
Radiation resistance is extremely low and must be modeled explicitly.
Efficiency depends heavily on conductor losses and phasing accuracy.
Mounting height affects pattern more than efficiency.
